name: Tachibana Seira
source: Kou's maternal aunt and the family member to whom he is most indebted to. A lady of character who founded the virtual corporation Ark Industries and built it up into the corporate giant it eventually became.
translation: 洸的姨妈，也是洸最亏欠的家人。她是一位品格高尚的女性，创立了虚拟企业方舟工业，并将其发展成最终的企业巨头。
